overall_topic.topic: The Owaisi-Azad Alliance in Uttar Pradesh Elections
overall_topic.description: A televised debate discussing the political implications, strategies, and potential electoral impact of the alliance formed between AIMIM (Asaduddin Owaisi) and Chandrasekhar Azad's Azad Samaj Party in Uttar Pradesh, focusing on whether they serve as a legitimate third front or merely act as opposition vote-cutters that benefit the ruling BJP.

evidence.text: So what does this new political equation mean?
You know, the Muslim vote goes to, gets divided.
And OIC is just a spoiler, as he always think he is.
Sir, you have always done... No, no.
Okay, I have understood your point.
But I think one thing what it does is, it puts pressure on Congress party.
So yeah, they can talk about, the friendship is there with the BJP and it is very, very apparent.
We don't go to them because it doesn't help polarize elections.
Yeah, that's an obnoxious comment by Mr. Sethi to say that there is actually some sort of an enmity or act coming between the Dalits and the pundits.
